extracted.name: Slow Cooker Buffalo Chicken Wing Soup
extracted.description: A true Buffalo chicken wing soup done with a slow cooker contains all the flavor of the original wings in a hearty soup.
ingredient_lines: 3 (10.75 ounce) cans condensed cream of chicken soup
1 cup hot pepper sauce, or to taste
instruction_lines: Combine half-and-half, chicken, soup, carrots, celery, potatoes, sour cream, and hot sauce in a slow cooler. Cover and cook on Low for 6 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally. Stir in blue cheese after 5 hours.
